stops.name: Langenberg Wildlife Park
stops.quote: Our Förderverein supports Langenberg Wildlife Park and the Sihlwald Nature Discovery Park.
stops.english: Our support association supports Langenberg Wildlife Park and the Sihlwald Nature Discovery Park.

stops.name: Sihlwald Nature Discovery Park
stops.quote: Watch lynx and bison at Langenberg Wildlife Park, or discover how the wilderness is reclaiming the forest at Sihlwald Nature Discovery Park.
stops.english: Watch lynx and bison at Langenberg Wildlife Park, or discover how the wilderness is reclaiming the forest at Sihlwald Nature Discovery Park.

stops.name: Winterwald
stops.quote: Im Winterwald suchen Sie nach Spuren, wie Wildtiere die kalte Jahreszeit meistern.
stops.english: In the winter forest you look for tracks of how wild animals master the cold season.

stops.name: Wildnispark Zürich Sihlwald
stops.quote: Geniessen Sie mit der Familie oder Freunden einen reichhaltigen Brunch inklusive geführtem kurzweiligem Spaziergang zu einem Wildtier im Park.
stops.english: Enjoy a rich brunch with family or friends, including a guided, entertaining walk to a wild animal in the park.
